item.title: Webhook delivery issue [resolved]
item.description:
SEEK recently updated the way webhook events are delivered, including a change to the casing of HTTP headers on those requests.
This may have impacted integrations that incorrectly treat HTTP header names as case-sensitive, even though HTTP header field names are case-insensitive under RFC 9110.
For reference: RFC 9110, section 5.1 https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html#section-5.1
This affected all webhook events sent between 2026-07-14 16:00:00 and 2026-07-15 14:30:00 AEST.
To mitigate the affect of this issue SEEK are replaying all webhook events that were sent during the incident window.

item.title: Missing webhook events [resolved]
item.description:
Incident Summary
Between 8 December 2025 and 3 February 2026, some webhook events were not delivered by the SEEK API. Specifically, PositionProfilePosted events were intermittently dropped during this period.
Impact - Some position profiles may not have appeared in your ATS during this time frame - Applications associated with those position profiles may also not have been reflected in your ATS
Resolution
All missing events have now been replayed.

item.title: SEEK API elevated error rate [postmortem]
item.description:
An internal networking change caused a complete SEEK API outage from 7:00pm to 8:36pm GMT\+11.
All inbound requests to `graphql.seek.com` timed out and no outbound webhook events were delivered during this period.
Candidates could not link out from a SEEK job ad to an external apply form during this time.
Requests to the domains `auth.seek.com` and `integration.seek.com` were unaffected.
SEEK will resend the wehbhook events that were missed during the period of 6:30pm to 9:36pm GMT\+11, see [https://developer.seek.com/events/webhooks#duplicates](https://developer.seek.com/events/webhooks#duplicates) for more information. This will commence from 12/02/2026 3:45pm GMT\+11.
